Upgrades.65342: A tire made for sliding. It grips like a street tire, but keeps most of that grip at big angles and under wheelspin, so the car holds a drift instead of snapping.
Upgrades.65344: Race springs and dampers set up for drifting: more caster and front camber, softer springs available and a lower ride height. Everything can be tuned afterwards.
Upgrades.65346: A race front anti-roll bar with a drift steering angle kit: modified knuckles and arms that let the front wheels turn much further, for big drift angles and an easier catch. Built for drifting: the extra lock does nothing for grip driving. The steering lock is tuned under Alignment.
Upgrades.65348: A close-ratio gearbox for drifting, built from the race transmission: evenly spaced gears, so every upshift lands the engine at the same revs instead of dropping it out of its power band, a taller first gear and a shorter final drive. Fully tunable.
Upgrades.65350: A limited-slip differential set up for drifting, built from the race differential: it locks the driven wheels together hard under power, so both keep spinning and the car holds its slide, with moderate lock off the throttle. On four-wheel drive it also sends most of the torque to the rear.
